title: epilobium tetragonum var. minutiflorum
intro: Epilobium tetragonum var. minutiflorum, commonly known as Dwarf Willowherb or Small-flowered Willowherb, is a plant species in the family Onagraceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to support urinary tract health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epilobium tetragonum var. minutiflorum include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
